Last Sunday, Nina and Owen went to the weekend breakfast. Nina and Owen had great fun there. Nina drinks milk after doing sports. What's more, smoke rose from the chimney.
Nina is going to travel to Sydney in October. The weekend breakfast is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like salad and milk. Also, eggs are rich in protein.

Nina thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the weekend breakfast by bike. Nina is reading a book about science. Best of all, wait until the bananas are ripe.
Nina hopes to visit Sydney one day. Nina learned a lot about science. They took many photos at the balcony.
